consult.blocking_finding: A22: A13's predicate is bypassable via git environment variables. gate/__init__.py:183 subprocess.run() inherits the caller's environment and does not clear GIT_DIR / GIT_WORK_TREE. With GIT_DIR=<main>/.git a linked-worktree status file flips path_is_in_worktree from True to False, so `GIT_DIR=/main/.git agentic gate /linked-worktree/WP.status.json` walks straight through the worktree refusal at both call sites.
consult.orchestrator_corroboration: Found independently by the orchestrator during the consult window, before reading codex's verdict. Confirmed at both call sites: finalize_merge.sh and codex_merge_gate.sh each emit their worktree-refusal message under a clean env and both fall through it under GIT_DIR spoofing (dying later on unrelated schema checks). cli.py:212 passes dict(os.environ) through unchanged and no wrapper unsets these vars. Narrowed the vector: GIT_DIR alone flips the predicate; GIT_WORK_TREE and GIT_COMMON_DIR alone do not.
consult.orchestrator_disagreement_on_severity: The orchestrator had rated this registration-level, not blocking, on three grounds: (1) the main defense holds - resolve_paths --root main_repo still returns the main root under GIT_DIR, GIT_WORK_TREE and GIT_COMMON_DIR spoofing, so relative status paths still land on the main copy; (2) strictly stronger than baseline, whose path literal missed all 8 worktrees in this repo with no env manipulation at all; (3) WP-08-candidate.md A13:913-916 and the Brief both define this guard as a backstop for absolute-path arguments. The orchestrator DEFERS to the consultant's REWORK: a security guard that a single env var defeats should not be merged as if it were sound, and the WP-17 lesson is precisely that the orchestrator's own severity judgement on a forgeable criterion is the thing that failed. Recorded, not overridden.
consult.fix_direction: Sanitize the environment inside the predicate: pass an env to subprocess.run with GIT_DIR, GIT_WORK_TREE, GIT_COMMON_DIR (and GIT_INDEX_FILE, GIT_OBJECT_DIRECTORY for good measure) removed, so the judgment reads the filesystem topology rather than caller-declared repository selection. Keep it one authoritative predicate; both call sites inherit the fix.
